caption:
110-SECOND GUIDED INVESTIGATION

Reset with a 50 g reference. Equal arm lengths and equal masses produce equal gravitational torques. Record a level comparison and calculate the sample mass from the known reference.

Changing any load resets the beam to level for a separate release. The guide explicitly resets between comparisons. Both views use the same calculated angle; pan suspension swing is excluded. Drag to orbit; scroll to zoom.
revision: Sustained oscillation guide: 49 g, 51 g, reduced damping, equal loads
